title: First Light / Whispers Before Dawn
theme: A missing ledger line pulls the player from Newport Harbor into counting-house pressure, tavern whisper culture, harbor rumors, and pre-Revolution unrest.

objectives.text: Make landfall at Newport Harbor and get your bearings.
Find Edrin Vale at the Counting House.
Ask the dockworkers, merchant row, or notice board about the missing ledger line.
Bring the missing-line rumor to Bess Armitage at the Tavern/Inn.
Choose a next lead: Edrin, the wharf, or the rear gate.
Look for the lantern signal at the wharf.
Secure a trusted contact before the rumor spreads.
Follow the island lead beyond Newport's eastern edge.
Take the old road toward the signal rise and hidden landing.
Search the hidden landing for proof of the missing manifest line.
Choose who receives the proof: Edrin at the Counting House or Annelise at the return lane.
Carry the proof into dawn before the Governor's men close the harbor.

opening_arc.hook_to_continue: Edrin becomes a named contact and asks the player to keep the missing line quiet until dawn.

progression.reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper and a named contact hook with Edrin Vale

island_npcs: Elias Ward - suspicious courier coded whisper
Mara Oren - coast patrol optional signal clue
Tomas Reed - dock runner hidden landing evidence
opening_island_extension.reward: Resolve +8 for proving the island clue, Annelise Crow as named contact, and access to the dawn signal hook

acceptance.reason_to_continue: Edrin names the dawn signal and the Governor's men.

opening_island_multipath_choice_extensio.purpose: Keep Whispers Before Dawn from becoming a single route after Newport by letting counting-house pressure, tavern rumor, harbor work, and optional island clue discovery all shape the island lead.
